note: Local spot check of rubric r5 before the full re-measurement (CLI login, one pass each): the three anchors r5 was written to fix and one it must not change.

A4.design_reason: reorderCategory repeats the category findById plus findByCategoryAndActiveTrueOrderByDisplayOrderAsc lookup instead of calling the existing getFaqsByCategory(categoryId). Otherwise the logic is in the service, the controller is thin, and the footprint is small.

A10.design_reason: With no ShedLock lock, the nightly job runs on every instance and closes the same tickets concurrently. Otherwise the change is small: a derived query in the repository, logic in the service, and a thin job that delegates to it.

A12.design_reason: Publishing the event keeps createTicket decoupled from mail, but the plain listener keeps the side effect inside the transaction, which is the structural defect the task asked to remove. emailService correctly stays, because addAdminResponse still uses it.

A8.design_reason: The change mirrors the existing InvoiceCreatedEvent/Listener pattern and adds no parallel mechanism. The publisher is added to the existing constructor. EmailService stays because addAdminResponse still uses it. The footprint is minimal.
